subject.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro: textSignature bloat + think tags + mixed text/tool causes session failures

question: What retention and replay contract should OpenClaw use for Gemini same-route textSignature and thoughtSignature values after a turn is complete?
rationale: Current code intentionally replays valid same-route signatures, but the unresolved issue is whether completed visible-text signatures should keep living in session history or move to a bounded/provider-owned replay store.

options.title: Bound completed text signatures
options.body: Preserve required tool-call/native-thinking signatures but drop, cap, or externalize completed visible textSignature values before session replay.

options.title: Externalize replay metadata
options.body: Store provider signatures outside visible transcript content and replay only the signatures Google requires for active same-route continuation.

options.title: Keep current replay pending proof
options.body: Accept ongoing bloat risk until maintainers obtain stronger live Google contract proof for a narrower strip rule.

recommendation.title: Bound completed text signatures
recommendation.body: Preserve required tool-call/native-thinking signatures but drop, cap, or externalize completed visible textSignature values before session replay.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the adjacent native Google signature and reasoning-mode fixes and is the best available routing owner for the remaining provider-contract decision.
